title: Start Day of an Activated Homesite Reservation Hold
content:
An activated Homesite Reservation hold is counted from one of three days: the activation date, the day the required funds became complete, or the reservation date. The day chosen fixes the activation start offset, the calendar days from the reservation date to the day the hold is counted from.

## Terms

- **Activation date.** The day the activation is written, which can fall after the day the required funds became complete when the activation was not written that day.
- **Day the required funds became complete.** The latest posting date of a payment received with the component reservation deposit, or, where the class carries a premium holding fee above zero, the later of that date and the latest posting date of a payment received with the component premium holding fee. Both are read from the payments on the reservation ledger.

## Rule

| Situation shown by the ledger and the activation date | Day the hold is counted from | Activation start offset |
|---|---|---|
| The required funds became complete on a day before the activation date | the activation date | the calendar days from the reservation date to the activation date |
| The required funds became complete on a day after the reservation date and the hold is activated that same day | the completion date | the calendar days from the reservation date to the completion date |
| Otherwise | the reservation date | zero |

## Training questions

**Funds complete on the reservation date and the hold activated that same day: what is the offset?** Neither of the first two rows applies, so the hold is counted from the reservation date and the offset is zero.

**Funds complete on the reservation date, activation written two days later: what is the offset?** The funds became complete on a day before the activation date, so the hold is counted from the activation date and the offset is 2.

## Date cases (hypothetical reservation dated 3 March)

| Funds complete | Activation written | Row | Offset (days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 March | 3 March | otherwise | 0 |
| 5 March | 5 March | completion date | 2 |
| 5 March | 7 March | activation date | 4 |
| 3 March | 6 March | activation date | 3 |

For a class with no premium holding fee, only the reservation deposit payments decide the completion day; for a class with a premium holding fee above zero, the later of the two latest posting dates decides it.
